theme: A clear day on the charter.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar, Dan — the day belongs to the boat. A couple of booking windows ashore are the only things asking for you this week.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat hotel cancellation locks tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Free cancellation on the Remisens Epidaurus room ends Sept 15, 11:59 PM CEST; after that it's non-refundable. The Sept 19 transfer, bag hold, and early Sunday checkout are still unarranged.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: This p1 Todoist item is due today. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early — book it refundable now, adjust dates later.

needsAttention.title: St Pete car and landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-Oct 5 full-size SUV at TPA and the Sept 20-22 St Pete lodging are both still open. You land Sunday the 20th; the kids' pickup is Tuesday the 22nd, so don't arrive without the car booked.

flagged.title: Megan messaged you on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn message is waiting for your response — worth a glance given the active search.

flagged.title: Provider bill ready to pay
flagged.detail: A healthcare provider flagged a bill from an Aug 18 visit as ready; a separate $35 payment also cleared today.

flagged.title: Event invitation from Ellen Fries
flagged.detail: An invite for Oct 2 at 2 PM — RSVP once you're back ashore.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — NYT Cooking, WSJ, Responsible Investor, and the usual language and travel digests.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first crisp beets and bitter escarole to the market, a natural match for a seared chop.

tasks.title: Confirm Nautilus return transfer for Sept 19

acts.line: The calendar is empty end to end — a rare open stretch with nothing to be anywhere for.
Nothing pulls at the afternoon; it's yours to spend on the water.
The evening is unscheduled — the only clock ashore is a booking window, not an appointment.
